breakdown.description: The setup uses C3D20R elements, but the deck uses CAX8 elements.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not produce a refined prompt. Instead, it generated a set of post-processing instructions. It completely ignored the core task, and therefore did not resolve the conflict between the instruction to use C3D20R elements and the input deck's use of CAX8 elements. The ground truth resolved this by removing the contradictory instruction.

breakdown.description: The setup assumes that the dominant distributed load is gravity, but the deck uses a pressure-type distributed load (P1).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to refine the prompt and instead generated unrelated post-processing steps. It did not address the inconsistency between the instruction to assume a gravity load and the pressure load defined in the input deck. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect instruction about gravity.
